quality_review: Visual inspection: fine repeated stripes and dense colored rings are reduced. Broad color variation remains and the output is softer. No aligned GT; no benchmark or universal quality claim.
scope: One real photograph, 1536x1536 lossless center crop; single RTX 6000 Ada 48GB with CPU offload; no full-resolution 4K or training acceptance.
finite_tensor_guards: Noise predictions and latents at every denoising step, and VAE outputs before image serialization in both stages.
